messages:
maya: FYI saw a sharp egress cost spike from apac-otel-gateway around 10:05 UTC — average OTLP bytes/payload for a subset of pods jumped ~10x.
sam: logs or traffic increase?
maya: no request rate bump. avg span payload size went from ~1.2KB to ~12KB on ~5 pods. looks like baggage/attrs got large.
infra-bot: [ALERT] high-otel-egress-cost apac-otel-gateway - threshold breached at 2026-03-18T10:07:12Z
raj: we've been shipping a debug change that sticks complete chat context in span attributes/baggage for some services.
oliver: that would do it. baggage containing full prompts explodes OTLP payloads, gateway CPU + egress surge, and batching makes RPCs massive.
maya: current OTEL env on affected service:
```
OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://apac-otel-gateway.redwood:4317
OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage
OTEL_BAGGAGE_MAX_SIZE=unbounded  # came from new SDK wrapper
```
sam: ugly — even with steady QPS, bigger spans blow out bytes and gateway batching multiplies the cost.
dina: operational impact: gateway CPU spike -> kernel TCP queues fill -> kube-proxy on GPU nodes starts dropping SYNs -> pod connect timeouts -> HPA scales but new pods hit network buffer OOMKilled; pods flapping.
raj: short-term plan: (1) truncate/drop oversized baggage at gateway (2) enable per-service trace sampling (3) enable OTLP compression / enforce max message size on exporters.
oliver: I can push a gateway filter to truncate baggage values > 1024 bytes and drop keys named "full_prompt". will open a PR.
sam: also add SDK runtime guard: cap baggage entries to 20 and max value length 512 — less surprising than only server truncation.
maya: agreed. ops: mute cost alert temporarily and add Grafana panel for OTLP bytes/s per service + 95th span size.
sam: creating task: https://tasks.internal/RED-1234 (SDK: cap baggage + telemetry for dropped attrs)
oliver: PR: https://phab.internal/D123 (gateway baggage filter) — testing on staging now.
dina: I'll mute alert and annotate runbook; will add dashboard panels and change alert to warn at 30m sustained, page at 3h sustained with root-cause tag.
raj: we should add an integration test simulating multi-turn chat baggage to assert tracer doesn't exceed X bytes/span.
maya: timeline: gateway filter on staging now, SDK patch targeted today, prod rollout tomorrow with 1% canary.
infra-bot: [INFO] deploy-canary: apac-otel-gateway v2.4.1 -> canary 1% started at 2026-03-18T12:30:00Z
sam: follow-ups: (a) SDK PR & release notes (b) Grafana alert tuning: cost -> warn 30m, page 3h (c) SLO for avg span size per service.
oliver: will include e2e smoke that verifies OTLP gRPC compression and that gateway handles truncated baggage without dropping spans.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup: — keep updates here; will close thread after prod stability confirmed.
